q13_informant.title: The Informant Reports
q13_informant._comment: Code quest: sim/society/informant_mod.gd (QuestLog module). Fee mult is a petition_fee_mult mod while the Informant reports.

report.text: {who} files a daily report on you. Petition fees climb with it.

tolerate.label: Tolerate the reports
tolerate.text: The reports continue. His rations do not.
tolerate.hint: Fee up to +30% while he lives. His rations are cut.

false_info.label: Feed false information
false_info.text: A Clerk spends a day on fiction. The Warden loves fiction.
false_info.hint: Needs a Clerk (loses his work day). Ends the reports.

transfer.label: Transfer him out
transfer.text: {who} is transferred to a better block. Nobody asks which.
transfer.hint: Loses a worker. Ends the reports, fee back to normal.
